text.feels_intro: How {name}'s slash wounds feel right now; let this shape {his} tone, posture and movement:
text.feels_outro: Answer must be creative and different, repetition will be punished.

head: {name}'s face: a shallow red cut runs across {his} cheek or brow, beaded with blood.
{name}'s face: a deep gash gapes along {his} cheek, bleeding steadily down {his} jaw.
{name}'s face: a ragged, bone-deep slash splits {his} face open; blood sheets over {his} features and one eye is lost in it.
body: {name}'s back: a thin red line of a cut, weeping a little blood through {his} clothing.
{name}'s back: a long, open gash soaks {his} clothing with blood.
{name}'s back: a deep, ragged slash cuts through muscle; blood runs freely and {his} clothing is sodden with it.
arm: {name}'s {part}: a shallow cut, welling blood in a thin red line.
{name}'s {part}: a deep gash laid open along the muscle, blood running to the fingertips.
{name}'s {part}: the slash cuts to the bone; the arm hangs heavy and dripping.
leg: {name}'s {part}: a shallow cut across the thigh or calf, blood seeping into {his} clothing.
{name}'s {part}: a deep gash, blood running down into {his} boot.
{name}'s {part}: a ragged slash through the muscle; the leg is slick with blood and barely holds weight.

head: {name}'s face stings sharply where the blade cut, and {he} keeps blinking away blood. {name} is wary and alert.
{name}'s face throbs under the open gash, {his} cheek hot and tight. {name} is rattled and angry, talking through a stiff jaw.
{name}'s face is a screaming, sickening pain; {he} is dizzy and sick with the blood loss. {name} is terrified and barely coherent.
body: {name}'s back stings every time {he} moves, a thin burning line. {name} is edgy and keeps shifting away from touch.
{name}'s back burns and pulls with every breath. {name} is gritting {his} teeth and moving stiffly to keep the wound closed.
{name}'s back is tearing, white-hot agony; {he} is lightheaded and shaking. {name} is close to collapse and cannot straighten up.
arm: {name}'s {part} stings sharply, and {he} flexes the fingers to check it still works.
{name}'s {part} burns deep and bleeds when {he} grips anything. {name} is angry and cradles it.
{name}'s {part} is agony and barely answers; {he} cannot grip. {name} is in shock, staring at the wound.
leg: {name}'s {part} stings with each step. {name} is annoyed, with a small hitch in {his} stride.
{name}'s {part} burns and bleeds with every step. {name} limps and grimaces, favoring it.
{name}'s {part} is shrieking pain; {he} can hardly stand on it. {name} is panicked and needs support to move.

levels: , a clean, hot line of pain. The edge bites and opens the skin, and {he} sucks in a sharp breath as the blood wells.
across flesh that is already cut. The blade finds the open wound again, and {he} cries out as the pain flares white-hot.
, and the blade bites deep into the wound. The pain is huge and nauseating, and {his} composure breaks as the blood pours.
, and it is too much. The blow cuts through muscle and tendon; {he} goes pale, {his} vision tunnels and {his} legs begin to give.

stage.medium: The gash on {name}'s {part} has closed into a raw, stitched-shut-looking cut.
stage.light: The cut on {name}'s {part} has knit into a thin pink line.
stage.healed: The cut on {name}'s {part} has healed, leaving a faint pale scar.

heal.source_healed: All of {name}'s slash wounds have healed.

start.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light, beginning to heal {own} wounds and pain.

pain_gone.none: The pain from {name}'s injuries is gone, but the healing continues.
pain_gone.source: The warm light of {owner_lc} {noun} has taken the pain from {own} injuries, but the healing continues.

full.none: {name}'s injuries are now fully healed, leaving {him} without pain or blemish.

full.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light. {name}'s injuries are now fully healed, leaving {him} without pain or blemish.

heal_events.stopped: The warm light of {owner_lc} {noun} fades before the healing is done; {own} injuries are {progress}.
